name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

variables:
  - name: mesx-agent-pool
    value: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

extends:
  template: "jobs/megalinter.yml@pipelines"
  parameters:
    job_pool: $(mesx-agent-pool)
    megalinter_image_name: oxsecurity/megalinter-ci_light
    megalinter_configuration:
      - name: DISABLE
        value: SPELL
      - name: DISABLE_LINTERS
        value: YAML_V8R
    publish_to_sonarqube: true
    sonar_process_parameters:
      - name: agent_pool
        value: $(mesx-agent-pool)

extends: default

ignore-from-file: [.gitignore, .yamlignore]

rules:
  document-start: disable
  line-length: disable

FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/ubuntu:24.04

COPY websocat /usr/local/bin/websocat
COPY externalscaler.proto /opt/proto/externalscaler.proto

RUN apt update \
    && apt install -y \
        inetutils-ping \
        netcat-traditional \
        qperf \ 
        netperf \
        hping3 \
        traceroute \
        iperf3 \
        dnsutils \
        curl \
        wget \
    && chmod a+x /usr/local/bin/websocat \
    && GRPCURL_VERSION=$(wget -qO- "https://api.github.com/repos/fullstorydev/grpcurl/releases/latest" | grep '"tag_name":' | sed -E 's/.*"v([^"]+)".*/\1/') \
    && wget -O grpcurl.tar.gz "https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/releases/download/v${GRPCURL_VERSION}/grpcurl_${GRPCURL_VERSION}_linux_x86_64.tar.gz" \
    && tar -xzf grpcurl.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin \
    && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/grpcurl \
    && rm grpcurl.tar.gz \
    && apt clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

CMD ["tail", "-f", "/dev/null"]

# Troubleshooting container app image

This repo contains a cusom image used for container app environment troubleshooting

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: trblsht

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      repository: mesx/troubleshooting-ca
      npmauth: false

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
